papers.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
papers.desc: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures significantly expand model capacity without a proportional increase in computational cost.

papers.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
papers.desc: LLMs have evolved from language generators to autonomous agents capable of complex, long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.desc: Recent omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) show great potential as real-time video assistants, which continuously perceive environments and guide users to achieve specific goals.

papers.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
papers.desc: With large pretrained models, existing methods have effectively improved instruction-based video editing.

papers.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
papers.desc: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count.

papers.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data.

papers.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
papers.desc: Real-world image search queries are multimodal and compositional: ``find this shirt in pink'' specifies an entity to retain, an attribute to modify, and context to ignore.

papers.title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
papers.desc: Semantic vision encoders have become a central visual interface for multimodal understanding and semantic conditioning in image generation.

papers.title: AgentMercury: Your Agent Can Synthesize Verifiable Environments for Business Scenarios at scale
papers.desc: Agents learn to act through interaction with environments, yet the environments used for training are often manually constructed or synthesized around predefined tasks and benchmarks.

papers.title: Towards Faithful Simulation of Human Shopping Behavior
papers.desc: Simulating realistic user shopping behavior underpins offline evaluation and reinforcement learning in e-commerce scenarios.

papers.title: Human-Centric Intelligence in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey
papers.desc: Human-centric intelligence is evolving in the foundation-model era, with growing emphasis on scale, transferability, and general-purpose modeling.

papers.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
papers.desc: Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards.

papers.title: FlavourBench: Ranking Frontier Language Models with Executable Culinary Ground Truth
papers.desc: Open-ended language-model benchmarks usually inherit a judge: a human preference panel, another model, or a brittle exact-match key.

papers.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment
papers.desc: Improving the safety of large language models (LLMs) often comes at the expense of utility, as globally applied safety tuning may affect model responses to both harmful and benign inputs.

papers.title: Hadith computational science in the age of large language models: a critical narrative review
papers.desc: We examine how hadith computational science is being reshaped by transformer models, retrieval-grounded pipelines, and large language models (LLMs).
